dockworkers_strike.title: The Docks Go Quiet
dockworkers_strike.description: Dockworkers have downed tools over pay, and cargo is rotting on the quays. Their union leader says the strike ends the moment the treasury opens its purse.

wandering_merchant.title: A Wandering Merchant
wandering_merchant.description: A caravan master with an impressive hat offers crates of foreign goods at a price he swears is robbery. Whose robbery, he does not say.

bumper_harvest.title: A Bumper Harvest
bumper_harvest.description: The granaries are overflowing after the best season in living memory. Farmers want the surplus sold abroad; the ministry of food wants it stored for leaner years.

mine_collapse.title: Collapse at the Iron Pits
mine_collapse.description: A shaft at the largest iron mine has caved in. The miners are safe, but the owners say reopening it will take money the treasury would rather keep.

options.text: Seize the mine for the state

inventor_petition.title: The Eccentric Inventor
inventor_petition.description: An inventor claims her new furnace doubles steel output, and she needs only a modest grant. Her last invention exploded, but she insists that was the point.

refugee_column.title: Refugees at the Border
refugee_column.description: Thousands of families fleeing a neighbouring war have reached the frontier. They bring skills and hungry mouths in roughly equal measure.

options.text: Open the gates and feed them

minister_scandal.title: The Minister's Yacht
minister_scandal.description: A newspaper has photographed the Minister of Finance aboard a yacht nobody can explain. The opposition is demanding his head; his friends are demanding silence.

options.text: Sack him and seize the yacht

harvest_festival.title: The Harvest Festival
harvest_festival.description: Citizens want a grand national festival this year. It would lift spirits across the country and empty a good number of warehouses doing it.

options.text: Throw the festival of the century

smuggler_ring.title: A Smuggling Ring Uncovered
smuggler_ring.description: Customs officers have caught a ring moving diamonds through the northern ports. The smugglers offer to cut the state in if it looks the other way.

options.text: Arrest them and seize the haul

foreign_envoy.title: An Envoy Bearing Gifts
foreign_envoy.description: A foreign envoy arrives with chests of aluminium and a treaty proposal written in very small print. The gifts are real; the treaty's intentions are less clear.

options.text: Accept the gifts, refuse the treaty

river_flood.title: The River Bursts Its Banks
river_flood.description: Spring floods have swamped farmland along the great river. Engineers can build levees now, or the state can pay out compensation when the waters recede.

spy_caught.title: A Spy in the Ministry
spy_caught.description: Counter-intelligence has caught a foreign agent photographing defence plans. He offers to become a double agent in exchange for his freedom.

options.text: Turn him into a double agent

snap_election.title: Calls for a Snap Election
snap_election.description: Parliament is deadlocked and the press smells blood. Calling an election would clear the air, but campaigns cost money and promises cost more.

railway_proposal.title: The Great Railway
railway_proposal.description: Engineers propose a railway linking the mines to the capital. It would take a mountain of steel and lumber, and pay for itself for decades.

plague_outbreak.title: Fever in the Slums
plague_outbreak.description: A fever is spreading through the capital's poorest districts. Doctors want the markets closed; merchants want them open.

border_dispute.title: The Disputed Valley
border_dispute.description: A neighbour claims a fertile valley on your border, citing a map older than both nations. Their troops are camped on the ridge, waiting.

oil_discovery.title: Oil in the Marshes
oil_discovery.description: Surveyors have struck oil beneath a protected marshland. Drilling would make the state rich and the birdwatchers furious.

bank_run.title: A Run on the Banks
bank_run.description: Rumours of insolvency have sent crowds to the bank doors. If the state does not act, the panic could spread to every counting house in the land.

options.text: Close the banks for a week

arms_dealer.title: The Arms Dealer's Offer
arms_dealer.description: A discreet gentleman offers surplus ammunition at a fraction of the market price. He is vague about where it came from and specific about the payment.

copper_boom.title: The Copper Rush
copper_boom.description: Prospectors have found copper in the southern hills and are flooding in by the thousand. The state can tax the rush or claim the richest seams itself.

options.text: Let the free market sort it out

power_blackout.title: The Lights Go Out
power_blackout.description: An overloaded grid has plunged half the country into darkness. Factories are idle and the evening news is being read by candlelight.

university_request.title: The Grand University
university_request.description: Scholars petition for a national university to rival the great academies abroad. It would be expensive, prestigious, and slow to pay off.

timber_baron.title: The Timber Baron
timber_baron.description: A timber baron wants rights to clear the ancient northern forest. He offers a generous fee and promises to plant saplings, eventually, somewhere.

options.text: Log it as a state enterprise

silver_counterfeit.title: Counterfeit Coins
silver_counterfeit.description: Forged silver coins are circulating in the markets, and shopkeepers are refusing coins altogether. The mint says it can fix this, for a price.

uranium_offer.title: Uranium for Sale
uranium_offer.description: A struggling foreign regime offers uranium in exchange for food. The deal would make the generals very happy and the diplomats very nervous.

factory_fire.title: Fire at the Munitions Works
factory_fire.description: A fire has gutted the main munitions factory. Investigators suspect sabotage, but the immediate question is whether to rebuild bigger or smaller.

drought.title: The Long Drought
drought.description: No rain has fallen in three months and the wells are running dry. Farmers are selling their livestock and eyeing the city reservoirs.

options.text: Open the city reservoirs to farms

bauxite_contract.title: The Aluminium Contract
bauxite_contract.description: A foreign aircraft maker wants a long-term bauxite contract. The price is good, but it would tie up a large share of your mines for years.

general_coup_rumour.title: Whispers of a Coup
general_coup_rumour.description: Intelligence suggests a popular general is sounding out officers about 'restoring order'. He has not done anything illegal, yet.

options.text: Promote him to a distant post

lead_pipes.title: Poison in the Pipes
lead_pipes.description: Doctors have traced a wave of illness to old lead water pipes in the capital. Replacing them is urgent, and the old lead is worth something to someone.
